name: LinkTempo
description: Get/set the tempo of the server's Ableton Link clock in cycles per second (cps). Returns -1.0 if Link session not started. Requires scsynth built with Link support.

inputs.name: gate
inputs.description: If >0, sets the tempo (second argument) and publishes to other clients

inputs.name: tempo
inputs.description: Tempo to set in cycles per second (cps). Link allows BPM in [20, 999] which is cps in [1/3, 16.65]

unavailable_reason: Ableton Link UGen plugin/source not installed or verified on this host.

name: LinkPhase
description: Access the phase of the server's Ableton Link clock. Phase runs from [0, quantum) with the current cps. Returns -1.0 if Link session not started. Requires scsynth built with Link support.

inputs.name: quantum
inputs.description: Quantum value the global step count is taken modulo by; clients sharing a quantum share the same phase

unavailable_reason: Ableton Link UGen plugin/source not installed or verified on this host.

name: LinkJump
description: Jump to a position within the quantum of the server's Ableton Link clock. Returns -1.0 if Link session not started, otherwise 0.0. Requires scsynth built with Link support.

inputs.name: gate
inputs.description: Gate >0 invokes a jump using the following arguments

inputs.name: beat
inputs.description: Target beat b within 0 <= b < quantum

inputs.name: quantum
inputs.description: Quantum value identifying the beat within the induced grid

inputs.name: force
inputs.description: If >0, rudely re-maps the beat/time relationship for all peers; otherwise attempts to map the given beat to the given time

unavailable_reason: Ableton Link UGen plugin/source not installed or verified on this host.
